name: Wolff House
use: Formerly SHARPP offices (8 Ballard St); SHARPP has moved to Smith Hall
style: Late-19th/early-20th-century wood-frame house with twin front gables and bays (from photo)
statusNote: Phase 1 closure list, Oct 2025; SHARPP moved to Smith Hall

facts.text: One of six Durham buildings UNH proposed for first-phase closure in October 2025.
SHARPP now lists 'our new location in Smith Hall (3rd Floor)'; its page header image is still labeled 'UNH Wolff House'.

photos.caption: Green clapboard house with twin gables and a ramped porch

tnh_close.title: TRIO Scholars and Sustainability Institute prepare to relocate (Dec 12, 2025; updated Mar 12, 2026)

verdict: A well-kept twin-gabled clapboard house on Ballard Street, emptied by SHARPP's move and slated for closure.
notes: Not in the UNH Library Archives building lists, so build year and history are unknown. The 8 Ballard St address comes only from a course-syllabus snippet and Foursquare (not opened). Accessibility 'partial' is from the 2013 photo, which shows a wooden wheelchair ramp to the porch; nothing published. The photo shows a modest, well-kept two-and-a-half-story house in residential scale.
judgeNotes: Photo shows a tidy house with a wooden ramp; history unknown.
